subject: general
question: In September 2022, the Daspara village in ________– which is solely dependent on agriculture and fishery – was converted to a nature - based lifestyle and livelihood while reducing the use of chemical fertilisers, becoming India’s first modified bio village.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daspara village** in Tripura was converted to a nature-based lifestyle and livelihood, becoming India's first modified bio village in September 2022.
 
• The village is solely dependent on **agriculture and fishery**.
 
• This transition included **reducing the use of chemical fertilizers** and adopting more sustainable practices.
 
• This initiative reflects a growing trend towards sustainable development and environmental conservation in rural India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tripura is known for its diverse culture and natural beauty, making it an ideal location for such sustainable initiatives.
 
• The state government has been actively promoting **organic farming and sustainable agricultural practices** to improve the livelihood of its farmers.
 
• Such initiatives are crucial for **environmental conservation** and can serve as a model for other regions in India.
